chunks: From him, from ʿAlī ibn Ibrāhīm, from his father, from Ḥammād, from Ḥarīz, from Muḥammad ibn Muslim, who said:

I asked Abā ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام about a man who is performing salat and does not know whether he has prayed one rakʿah or two. He said: He starts again until he becomes certain that he has completed it; and this applies in the Friday prayer, the maghrib prayer, and the prayer during travel.
ai.seo_question: What should a person do if he doubts whether he prayed one or two rakʿahs in Jumuʿah, maghrib, or travel prayer?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling for one who doubts, in certain prayers, whether he has performed one rakʿah or two. The Imam عليه السلام instructs that he must begin the prayer anew until he attains certainty of completion, specifically in Jumuʿah, maghrib, and prayers performed during travel.
